verses.sloka: तेषामञ्जलिपद्मानि प्रगृहीतानि सर्वशः ।प्रतिगृह्याब्रवीद्राजा तेभ्यः प्रियहितं वचः ॥२-३-१॥
verses.transliteration: teṣāmañjalipadmāni pragṛhītāni sarvaśaḥ ।pratigṛhyābravīdrājā tebhyaḥ priyahitaṁ vacaḥ ॥2-3-1॥

translations.english: The citizens held out their palms folded like lotuses in reverence and urged king Dasaratha in all possible ways (to coronate Rama). He reciprocated their respect with words preasing and beneficial to them:

verses.sloka: अहोऽस्मि परमप्रीतः प्रभावश्चातुलो मम ।यन्मे ज्येष्ठं प्रियं पुत्रं यौवराज्यस्थ मिच्छथ ॥२-३-२॥
verses.transliteration: aho'smi paramaprītaḥ prabhāvaścātulo mama ।yanme jyeṣṭhaṁ priyaṁ putraṁ yauvarājyastha micchatha ॥2-3-2॥

translations.english: I am immensely happy that you have added to my incomparable resilience with your desire to see my beloved eldest son installed heirapparent.
translations.hindi: हविषमात्र को नमस्कार कर विधिपूर्वक, श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने श्रीरङ्गनाथ के प्रीत्यथ, (अथवा नारायण मंत्र से) जलते हुए अग्नि में धी की आहुतियाँ दीं

verses.sloka: इति प्रत्यर्च्य तान् राजा ब्राह्मणानिद मब्रवीत् ।वसिष्ठं वामदेवं च तेषामेवोपशृण्वताम् ॥२-३-३॥
verses.transliteration: iti pratyarcya tān rājā brāhmaṇānida mabravīt ।vasiṣṭhaṁ vāmadevaṁ ca teṣāmevopaśṛṇvatām ॥2-3-3॥

translations.english: ﻿ Having honoured them (the invitees) in return for their response, king Dasaratha addressed Vasistha, Vamadeva and other brahmins.
translations.hindi: तदनन्तर हवन करने से बचे हुए हविष्यान्न को भक्षण कर, "और अपने मङ्गल के लिए प्राथना कर और श्रीरङ्गनाथ भगवान ' का ध्यान करते हुए, कुशासन पर,

verses.sloka: चैत्रः श्रीमानयं मासः पुण्यः पुष्पितकाननः ।यौवराज्याय रामस्य सर्वमेवोपकल्प्यताम् ॥२-३-४॥
verses.transliteration: caitraḥ śrīmānayaṁ māsaḥ puṇyaḥ puṣpitakānanaḥ ।yauvarājyāya rāmasya sarvamevopakalpyatām ॥2-3-4॥

translations.english: This auspicious month of Chaitra is sacred with its blossoming groves. Let all the arrangements be made for the installation of Rama as heirapparent. On hearing this, all the members of the assembly applauded the king tumultously.

verses.sloka: राज्ञस्तूपरते वाक्ये जनघोषो महानभूत् ।शनैस्तस्मिन् प्रशान्ते च जनघोषे जनाधिपः ॥२-३-५॥
verses.transliteration: rājñastūparate vākye janaghoṣo mahānabhūt ।śanaistasmin praśānte ca janaghoṣe janādhipaḥ ॥2-3-5॥

translations.english: With the tumult gradually calmed down, the lord of the people, the king (Dasaratha) spoke this to Vasistha, a tiger among ascetics:

verses.sloka: वसिष्ठं मुनिशार्दूलं राजा वचनमब्रवीत् ।अभिषेकाय रामस्य यत्कर्म सपरिच्छदम् ॥२-३-६॥
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭhaṁ muniśārdūlaṁ rājā vacanamabravīt ।abhiṣekāya rāmasya yatkarma saparicchadam ॥2-3-6॥

translations.english: O revered one, you should issue appropriate orders to keep ready the necessary articles required for the performance of installation ceremony of Rama.
translations.hindi: सूतों, मागधों और बंदीजनों की सुखदायक बाणियों को .खुनते हुए प्रात:सन्ध्योपासन्‌ कर, एकाग्रचित्त से गायत्री का जप करने लगे

verses.sloka: तदद्य भगवन् सर्वमाज्ञापयितु मर्हसि ।तच्छ्रुत्वा भूमिपालस्य वसिष्ठो द्विजसत्तमः ॥२-३-७॥
verses.transliteration: tadadya bhagavan sarvamājñāpayitu marhasi ।tacchrutvā bhūmipālasya vasiṣṭho dvijasattamaḥ ॥2-3-7॥

translations.english: Hearing the words of the king, Vasistha, best of the brahmins thus ordered the counsellors who stood in front of the king with folded palms:
translations.hindi: सन्ध्योपासन और जप करके उन्होंने सूयोन्तवर्ती नारायण की स्तुति कर उनको प्रणाम किया । तदनन्तर नया रेशमी वस्त्र पहन और ब्राह्मणों को बुलबा कर, उनसे स्वस्तिवाचन और पुण्याहवाचन करवाया

verses.sloka: आदिदेशाग्रतो राज्ञः स्थितान् युक्तान् कृताञ्जलीन् ।सुवर्णादीनि रत्नानि बलीन् सर्वौषधीरपि ॥२-३-८॥
verses.transliteration: ādideśāgrato rājñaḥ sthitān yuktān kṛtāñjalīn ।suvarṇādīni ratnāni balīn sarvauṣadhīrapi ॥2-3-8॥

translations.english: ﻿ By tomorrow early morning arrange in the place set aside for sacred fire in the king's palace gold and other metals, gems, articles of worship, also herbs, garlands of white flowers, roasted corn, honey and clarified butter in separate containers, fresh clothes, chariot, weapons of every kind, army of four divisions, an elephant possessing auspicious marks, white fans made of Yak's hair, a standard, white parasol, a hundred golden vessels shining like fire, a bull with goldplated horns and a tiger skin.

verses.sloka: शुक्लमाल्यांश्च लाजांश्च पृथक्च मधुसर्पिषी ।अहतानि च वासांसि रथं सर्वायुधान्यपि ॥२-३-९॥
verses.transliteration: śuklamālyāṁśca lājāṁśca pṛthakca madhusarpiṣī ।ahatāni ca vāsāṁsi rathaṁ sarvāyudhānyapi ॥2-3-9॥

translations.english: ﻿ By tomorrow early morning arrange in the place set aside for sacred fire in the king's palace gold and other metals, gems, articles of worship, also herbs, garlands of white flowers, roasted corn, honey and clarified butter in separate containers, fresh clothes, chariot, weapons of every kind, army of four divisions, an elephant possessing auspicious marks, white fans made of Yak's hair, a standard, white parasol, a hundred golden vessels shining like fire, a bull with goldplated horns and a tiger skin.

verses.sloka: चतुरङ्गबलं चैव गजं च शुभलक्षणम् ।चामरव्यजने श्वेते ध्वजं छत्रं च पाण्डुरम् ॥२-३-१०॥
verses.transliteration: caturaṅgabalaṁ caiva gajaṁ ca śubhalakṣaṇam ।cāmaravyajane śvete dhvajaṁ chatraṁ ca pāṇḍuram ॥2-3-10॥

translations.english: ﻿ By tomorrow early morning arrange in the place set aside for sacred fire in the king's palace gold and other metals, gems, articles of worship, also herbs, garlands of white flowers, roasted corn, honey and clarified butter in separate containers, fresh clothes, chariot, weapons of every kind, army of four divisions, an elephant possessing auspicious marks, white fans made of Yak's hair, a standard, white parasol, a hundred golden vessels shining like fire, a bull with goldplated horns and a tiger skin.

verses.sloka: शतं च शातकुम्भानां  कुम्भानामग्निवर्चसाम् ।हिरण्यशृङ्गमृषभं समग्रं व्याघ्रचर्म च ॥२-३-११॥
verses.transliteration: śataṁ ca śātakumbhānāṁ  kumbhānāmagnivarcasām ।hiraṇyaśṛṅgamṛṣabhaṁ samagraṁ vyāghracarma ca ॥2-3-11॥

translations.english: By tomorrow early morning arrange in the place set aside for sacred fire in the king's palace gold and other metals, gems, articles of worship, also herbs, garlands of white flowers, roasted corn, honey and clarified butter in separate containers, fresh clothes, chariot, weapons of every kind, army of four divisions, an elephant possessing auspicious marks, white fans made of Yak's hair, a standard, white parasol, a hundred golden vessels shining like fire, a bull with goldplated horns and a tiger skin.
translations.hindi: जब प्रातःकाल हो गया, तब सब पुरवासो श्रीरामचन्द्र जी का राज ने हि ै दि 200 बु निति | सुन, नगर सजाने के लिए कदली-त्तम्भांदि सिताम्रशिखराभेषु देवतायतनेषु च। चतुष्पयेषु रथ्यासु चेस्येष्यट्टालकेषु च

verses.sloka: उपस्थापयत प्रातरग्न्यगारं महीपतेः ।यच्चान्यत्किञ्चिदेष्टव्यं तत्सर्वमुपकल्प्यताम् ॥२-३-१२॥
verses.transliteration: upasthāpayata prātaragnyagāraṁ mahīpateḥ ।yaccānyatkiñcideṣṭavyaṁ tatsarvamupakalpyatām ॥2-3-12॥

translations.english: Even the smallest items required be arranged. Let the gates of the inner apartment and of the entire city be decorated with sandalpaste and garlands. Let fragrant incense be burnt for worship.

verses.sloka: अस्तःपुरस्य द्वाराणि सर्वस्य नगरस्य च ।चन्दनस्रग्भिरर्च्यन्तां धूपैश्च घ्राणहारिभिः ॥२-३-१३॥
verses.transliteration: astaḥpurasya dvārāṇi sarvasya nagarasya ca ।candanasragbhirarcyantāṁ dhūpaiśca ghrāṇahāribhiḥ ॥2-3-13॥

translations.english: Even the smallest items required be arranged. Let the gates of the inner apartment and of the entire city be decorated with sandalpaste and garlands. Let fragrant incense be burnt for worship.
translations.hindi: तथा जितने सभाभवन थे, तथा जितने ऊचे-अँचे वृक्ष थे,. उन सब पर रंग-बिरंगी ध्वजापताकाएँ फहराई गई

verses.sloka: प्रशस्तमन्नं गुणवद्धधिक्षीरोपसेचनम् ।द्विजानां शतसाहस्रे यत्प्रकाममलं भवेत् ॥२-३-१४॥
verses.transliteration: praśastamannaṁ guṇavaddhadhikṣīropasecanam ।dvijānāṁ śatasāhasre yatprakāmamalaṁ bhavet ॥2-3-14॥

translations.english: Arrange fine rice cooked with milk and curd sufficient for a hundred thousand brahmins to eat to their heart's content.
translations.hindi: अयोध्या में जगह-जगह नटों-नतेकों के मन को प्रसन्न करने वाला और कणे-मधुर गाना-बजाना होने लगा और लोग सुनने लगे

verses.sloka: सत्कृत्य द्विजमुख्यानां श्वः प्रभाते प्रदीयताम् ।घृतं दधि च लाजाश्च दक्षिणाश्चापि पुष्कलाः ॥२-३-१५॥
verses.transliteration: satkṛtya dvijamukhyānāṁ śvaḥ prabhāte pradīyatām ।ghṛtaṁ dadhi ca lājāśca dakṣiṇāścāpi puṣkalāḥ ॥2-3-15॥

translations.english: At dawn tomorrow the best of brahmins be honoured with cooked rice clarified butter, curd, roasted corn and gifts in abundance.
translations.hindi: उस दिन हाट-बाट, घर-द्वार, भीतर-बाहर, जहाँ सुनो वहीं लोग श्रीरामाभिषेक ही की आपस में चचा करते सुन पड़ते थे

verses.sloka: सूर्येऽभ्युदितमात्रे श्वो भविता स्वस्तिवाचनम् ।ब्राह्मणाश्च निमन्त्र्यन्तां कल्प्यन्तामासनानि च ॥२-३-१६॥
verses.transliteration: sūrye'bhyuditamātre śvo bhavitā svastivācanam ।brāhmaṇāśca nimantryantāṁ kalpyantāmāsanāni ca ॥2-3-16॥

translations.english: As soon as the Sun rises tomorrow, arrangements be made for Swastivachana (a benedictory utterance). Brahmins be invited and seats provided to them.
translations.hindi: घरों के द्वारों पर खेलती हुई बालकों की टोलियों में भी आपस में श्री रामाभिषेक ही की चचो हो रही थी

verses.sloka: आबध्यन्तां पताकाश्च राजमार्गश्च सिच्यताम् ।सर्वे च ताLआवचरा गणिकाश्च स्वलंकृताः ॥२-३-१७॥
verses.transliteration: ābadhyantāṁ patākāśca rājamārgaśca sicyatām ।sarve ca tāLāvacarā gaṇikāśca svalaṁkṛtāḥ ॥2-3-17॥

translations.english: Banners be fastened and royal highways be sprinkled with water. All actors and beautifully adorned courtesans should reach the second inner apartment of the king's residence and remain seated there.
translations.hindi: उस दिन श्री रामाभिषेक के उपलक्ष्य में (राज्य की ओर ही से : ॥ ु नहीं, बल्कि प्रजा की ओर से भी ) लोगों ने पुष्प, धूप और तरह-- मनको र. >a हू तरह को सुगन्ध से वापि i स कर राजमाग को अच्छी त सजाया था

verses.sloka: कक्ष्यां द्वितीयामासाद्य तिष्ठन्तु नृपवेश्मनः ।देवायतनचैत्येषु सान्नभक्षाः सदक्षिणाः ॥२-३-१८॥
verses.transliteration: kakṣyāṁ dvitīyāmāsādya tiṣṭhantu nṛpaveśmanaḥ ।devāyatanacaityeṣu sānnabhakṣāḥ sadakṣiṇāḥ ॥2-3-18॥

translations.english: Persons to cater food and other eatables and to hold garlands and gifts be stationed at all temples and other places of worship.
translations.hindi: यह बिचार कर कि, कदाचित्‌ श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के लूर ) न्द्र उ जलूस के उधर से निकलते समय कहीं रात न हो जाय-लोगों ने रोशनी “करने के ,लिए सड़कों पर अलग-अलग सर्वत्र 'दीपवृक्त अथात्‌ पनशाखाए गाड़ रखी थीं या भाड़-फानूस टॉग रखे थे

verses.sloka: उपस्थापयितव्याः स्युर्माल्ययोग्याः पृथक् पृथक् ।दीर्घासिबद्धा योधाश्च सन्नद्धा मृष्टवाससः ॥२-३-१९॥
verses.transliteration: upasthāpayitavyāḥ syurmālyayogyāḥ pṛthak pṛthak ।dīrghāsibaddhā yodhāśca sannaddhā mṛṣṭavāsasaḥ ॥2-3-19॥

translations.english: Let all the warriors in fresh clothes, armed with long swords and fully alert enter the courtyard of the glorious king.

verses.sloka: महाराजाङ्गणं सर्वे प्रविशन्तु महोदयम् ।एवं व्यादिश्य विप्रौ तौ क्रियास्तत्र सुनिष्ठितौ ॥२-३-२०॥
verses.transliteration: mahārājāṅgaṇaṁ sarve praviśantu mahodayam ।evaṁ vyādiśya viprau tau kriyāstatra suniṣṭhitau ॥2-3-20॥

translations.english: The two highly selfdisciplined ascetics (Vasistha and Vamadeva), having ordered the tasks to be performed and whatever remained to be done reported to the king.
translations.hindi: कुंड के फुड लोग एकत्र हो चबूतरों पर और बैठकों में बैठ, आपस में महाराज दशरथ की 'चचौ चला, उनकी प्रशंसा कर रहे थे

verses.sloka: चक्रतुश्चैव यच्छेषं पार्थिवाय निवेद्य च ।कृतमित्येव चाब्रूतामभिगम्य जगत्पतिम् ॥२-३-२१॥
verses.transliteration: cakratuścaiva yaccheṣaṁ pārthivāya nivedya ca ।kṛtamityeva cābrūtāmabhigamya jagatpatim ॥2-3-21॥

translations.english: Satisfied with the arrangements, the two illustrious brahmins(Vasistha and Vamadeva) approached the lord of the earth (Dasaratha) with delight and said All things have been arranged in accordance with your word of command.
translations.hindi: चे कहते थे कि, अहो ! देखो, इच्वाकु-कुलनन्द्न महाराज दशरथ बड़े महात्मा हैं, जो अपने को ,बृद्ध हुआ जान, श्रीरामचन्द्र जी का राज्याभिषेक ( स्वयं ) कर रहे हैं

verses.sloka: यथोक्तवचनं प्रीतौ हर्षयुक्तौ द्विजर्षभौ ।ततः सुमन्त्रं द्युतिमान् राजा वचनमब्रवीत् ॥२-३-२२॥
verses.transliteration: yathoktavacanaṁ prītau harṣayuktau dvijarṣabhau ।tataḥ sumantraṁ dyutimān rājā vacanamabravīt ॥2-3-22॥

translations.english: Thereafter the glorious king said to Sumantra, Bring immediately the selfpossessed Rama.
translations.hindi: हम सब लोगों पर ( महाराज ने ) यह बड़ा आगर किया जो औरामचन््र हम लोगों के राजा हो रहे हैं। भगवान्‌ बहुत दिनों तक अपनी प्रजा का सब हाल जानने वाले ओर प्रजारक्षक श्रीरामचन्द्र को, हम लोगों का राजा बनाए रखे

verses.sloka: रामः कृतात्मा भवता शीघ्रमानीयतामिति ।स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय सुमन्त्रो राजशासनात् ॥२-३-२३॥
verses.transliteration: rāmaḥ kṛtātmā bhavatā śīghramānīyatāmiti ।sa tatheti pratijñāya sumantro rājaśāsanāt ॥2-3-23॥

translations.english: In response to the king's command Sumantra, the best of charioteers said, 'so be it' and fetched Rama in a chariot.
translations.hindi: क्योंकि श्रीरामचन्द्र जी सरल स्वभाव, परमविज्ञ, घमोत्मा ओर भाइयों पर कृपा रखने बाले हैं । वे अपने भाइयों पर सरल स्वभाव से जैसा स्नेह रखते हैं, वैसा ही स्नेह उनका हम लोगों के ऊपर भी है

verses.sloka: रामं तत्रानयांचक्रे रथेन रथिनां वरम् ।अथ तत्र समासीनास्तदा दशरथं नृपम् ॥२-३-२४॥
verses.transliteration: rāmaṁ tatrānayāṁcakre rathena rathināṁ varam ।atha tatra samāsīnāstadā daśarathaṁ nṛpam ॥2-3-24॥

translations.english: After Sumantra had gone, the kings from eastern, northern, western, southern nonAryan and Aryan countries, rulers from forests and mountains paid homage to king Dasaratha, as devatas do to Indra.

verses.sloka: प्राच्योदीच्याः प्रतीच्याश्च दाक्षिणात्याश्च भूमिपाः ।म्लेच्छाश्चार्याश्च ये चान्ये वने शैलान्तवासिनः ॥२-३-२५॥
verses.transliteration: prācyodīcyāḥ pratīcyāśca dākṣiṇātyāśca bhūmipāḥ ।mlecchāścāryāśca ye cānye vane śailāntavāsinaḥ ॥2-3-25॥

translations.english: After Sumantra had gone, the kings from eastern, northern, western, southern nonAryan and Aryan countries, rulers from forests and mountains paid homage to king Dasaratha, as devatas do to Indra.
translations.hindi: + ` रामराज्याभिषेक का संवाद सुन जो लोग बाहर से आकर अयोध्या में एकत्र हुए थे, उन. लोगों ने पुरवासियों की कही हुई ये बात सुनीं

verses.sloka: उपासाञ्चक्रिरे सर्वे तं देवा इव वासवम् ।तेषां मध्ये स राजर्षिर्मरुतामिव वासवः ॥२-३-२६॥
verses.transliteration: upāsāñcakrire sarve taṁ devā iva vāsavam ।teṣāṁ madhye sa rājarṣirmarutāmiva vāsavaḥ ॥2-3-26॥

translations.english: The rajarsi, (Dasaratha), seated among the kings like Indra amidst maruts, beheld his son Rama sitting in a chariot and approaching him.
translations.hindi: वे लोग चारों ओर के देशों से श्रीराम जी की अयोध्यापुरी में .. श्रीरामाभिपेकोत्सव देखने को आये थे । उन बाहरी लोगों के आगमन से अयोध्यापुरी में लोगों की बड़ी भासी भीड़ हो गई थी

verses.sloka: प्रासादस्थो रथगतं ददर्शायान्त मात्मजम् ।गन्धर्वराजप्रतिमं लोके विख्यातपौरुषम् ॥२-३-२७॥
verses.transliteration: prāsādastho rathagataṁ dadarśāyānta mātmajam ।gandharvarājapratimaṁ loke vikhyātapauruṣam ॥2-3-27॥

translations.english: Rama appeared as the very image of king of the gandharvas known for his courage in this world. With his long arms, he was extremely handsome with a countenance of the colour of moonstone possessed of immense strength, he walked with the gait of an intoxicated elephant. He captivated the eyes and hearts of men with his beauty and generosity. He looked like Parjanya (raingod), gladdening men scorched by heat. Even after (intensely) gazing at Rama approaching, the king (Dasaratha) was not satiated.

verses.sloka: दीर्घ बाहुं महसत्त्वं मत्तमातङ्गगामिनम् ।चन्द्रकान्ताननं राममतीव प्रियदर्शनम् ॥२-३-२८॥
verses.transliteration: dīrgha bāhuṁ mahasattvaṁ mattamātaṅgagāminam ।candrakāntānanaṁ rāmamatīva priyadarśanam ॥2-3-28॥

translations.english: Rama appeared as the very image of king of the gandharvas known for his courage in this world. With his long arms, he was extremely handsome with a countenance of the colour of moonstone possessed of immense strength, he walked with the gait of an intoxicated elephant. He captivated the eyes and hearts of men with his beauty and generosity. He looked like Parjanya (raingod), gladdening men scorched by heat. Even after (intensely) gazing at Rama approaching, the king (Dasaratha) was not satiated.

verses.sloka: रूपौदार्यगुणैः पुंसां दृष्टिचित्तापहारिणम् ।घर्माभितप्ताः पर्जन्यं ह्लादयन्तमिव प्रजाः ॥२-३-२९॥
verses.transliteration: rūpaudāryaguṇaiḥ puṁsāṁ dṛṣṭicittāpahāriṇam ।gharmābhitaptāḥ parjanyaṁ hlādayantamiva prajāḥ ॥2-3-29॥

translations.english: Rama appeared as the very image of king of the gandharvas known for his courage in this world. With his long arms, he was extremely handsome with a countenance of the colour of moonstone possessed of immense strength, he walked with the gait of an intoxicated elephant. He captivated the eyes and hearts of men with his beauty and generosity. He looked like Parjanya (raingod), gladdening men scorched by heat. Even after (intensely) gazing at Rama approaching, the king (Dasaratha) was not satiated.

verses.sloka: न ततर्प समायान्तं पश्यमानो नराधिपः ।अवतार्य सुमन्त्रस्तं राघवं स्यन्दनोत्तमात् ॥२-३-३०॥
verses.transliteration: na tatarpa samāyāntaṁ paśyamāno narādhipaḥ ।avatārya sumantrastaṁ rāghavaṁ syandanottamāt ॥2-3-30॥

translations.english: ﻿ Sumantra assisted Rama while alighting from that splendid chariot and followed him with folded palms as Rama was proceeding towards his father.

verses.sloka: पितुः समीपं गच्छन्तं प्राञ्जलिः पृष्ठतोऽन्वगात् ।स तं कैलासशृङ्गाभं प्रासादं नरपुङ्गवः ॥२-३-३१॥
verses.transliteration: pituḥ samīpaṁ gacchantaṁ prāñjaliḥ pṛṣṭhato'nvagāt ।sa taṁ kailāsaśṛṅgābhaṁ prāsādaṁ narapuṅgavaḥ ॥2-3-31॥

translations.english: ﻿ Best among men, Rama accompanied by charioteer Sumantra ascended that palace that was lofty as the peak of Kailasa mountain in order to see the king.

verses.sloka: आरुरोह नृपं द्रष्टुं सह सूतेन राघवः ।स प्राञ्^जलिरभिप्रेत्य प्रणतः पितुरन्तिके ॥२-३-३२॥
verses.transliteration: āruroha nṛpaṁ draṣṭuṁ saha sūtena rāghavaḥ ।sa prāñ^jalirabhipretya praṇataḥ piturantike ॥2-3-32॥

translations.english: Rama, approached his father with folded palms and bowed low near him, pronounced his (own) name and touched his father's feet with reverence.

verses.sloka: नाम स्वं श्रावयन् रामो ववन्धे चरणौ पितुः ।तं दृष्ट्वा प्रणतं पार्श्वे कृताञ्जलिपुटं नृपः ॥२-३-३३॥
verses.transliteration: nāma svaṁ śrāvayan rāmo vavandhe caraṇau pituḥ ।taṁ dṛṣṭvā praṇataṁ pārśve kṛtāñjalipuṭaṁ nṛpaḥ ॥2-3-33॥

translations.english: Seeing his beloved son Rama who was standing by his side with folded hands in supplication, king Dasaratha, held his folded hands and drew him near and embraced him.

verses.sloka: गृह्याञ्जलौ समाकृष्य सस्वजे प्रियमात्मजम् ।तस्मै चाभ्युदितं दिव्यं मणिकाञ्चनभूषितं ॥२-३-३४॥
verses.transliteration: gṛhyāñjalau samākṛṣya sasvaje priyamātmajam ।tasmai cābhyuditaṁ divyaṁ maṇikāñcanabhūṣitaṁ ॥2-3-34॥

translations.english: The king (Dasaratha) offered Rama a seat on the lofty, glorious throne splendidly decorated with gold and gems.

verses.sloka: दिदेश राजा रुचिरं रामाय परमासनम् ।तदासनवरं प्राप्य व्यदीपयत राघवः ॥२-३-३५॥
verses.transliteration: dideśa rājā ruciraṁ rāmāya paramāsanam ।tadāsanavaraṁ prāpya vyadīpayata rāghavaḥ ॥2-3-35॥

translations.english: The lofty seat Rama occupied was illuminated by him resplenderce like mount Meru in the translucent rays of the morning Sun.

verses.sloka: स्वयेव प्रभया मेरुमुदये विमलो रविः ।तेन विभ्राजता तत्र सा सभाभिव्यरोचत ॥२-३-३६॥
verses.transliteration: svayeva prabhayā merumudaye vimalo raviḥ ।tena vibhrājatā tatra sā sabhābhivyarocata ॥2-3-36॥

translations.english: ﻿ That assembly was illumined by (the presence of) Rama like the Moon dazzling the clear autumnal sky bespangled with sparkling planets and stars.

verses.sloka: विमलग्रहनक्षत्रा शारदी द्यौरिवेन्दुना ।तं पश्यमानो नृपति स्तुतोओष प्रियमात्मजम् ॥२-३-३७॥
verses.transliteration: vimalagrahanakṣatrā śāradī dyaurivendunā ।taṁ paśyamāno nṛpati stutooṣa priyamātmajam ॥2-3-37॥

translations.english: The king was delighted to see his beloved son as though he saw his own reflection adorning a mirror.

verses.sloka: अलङ्कृतमिवात्मानमादर्शतलसंस्थितम् ।स तं सस्मितमाभाष्य पुत्रं पुत्रवतां वरः ॥२-३-३८॥
verses.transliteration: alaṅkṛtamivātmānamādarśatalasaṁsthitam ।sa taṁ sasmitamābhāṣya putraṁ putravatāṁ varaḥ ॥2-3-38॥

translations.english: The best among fathers, he (Dasaratha) said these words to his son with a smile, like Kasyapa addressing Devendra.

verses.sloka: उवाचेदं वचो राजा देवेन्द्रमिव काश्यपः ।ज्येष्ठायामसि मे पत्न्यां सदृश्यां सदृशः सुतः ॥२-३-३९॥
verses.transliteration: uvācedaṁ vaco rājā devendramiva kāśyapaḥ ।jyeṣṭhāyāmasi me patnyāṁ sadṛśyāṁ sadṛśaḥ sutaḥ ॥2-3-39॥

translations.english: A worthy son of my worthy eldest wife, O Rama, your great virtues have endeared you to me.

verses.sloka: उत्पन्नस्त्वं गुणश्रेष्ठो मम रामात्मजः प्रियः ।यतस्त्वया प्रजाश्चेमाः स्वगुणैरनुरञ्जिताः ॥२-३-४०॥
verses.transliteration: utpannastvaṁ guṇaśreṣṭho mama rāmātmajaḥ priyaḥ ।yatastvayā prajāścemāḥ svaguṇairanurañjitāḥ ॥2-3-40॥

translations.english: As you have endeared yourself to these subjects with your virtues, you shall assume the office of heirapparent when Pushya star is in conjunction with the Moon.

verses.sloka: तस्मात्त्वं पुष्ययोगेन यौवराज्यमवाप्नुहि ।कामतस्त्वं प्रकृत्यैव विनीतो गुणवानसि ॥२-३-४१॥
verses.transliteration: tasmāttvaṁ puṣyayogena yauvarājyamavāpnuhi ।kāmatastvaṁ prakṛtyaiva vinīto guṇavānasi ॥2-3-41॥

translations.english: Admittedly gentle by nature, you are gifted with virtues. O son, even though virtuous, I shall offer you counsel for your good out of affection for you.

verses.sloka: गुणवत्यपि तु स्नेहात्पुत्र वक्ष्यामि ते हितम् ।भूयो विनयमास्थाय भव नित्यं जितेन्द्रियः ॥२-३-४२॥
verses.transliteration: guṇavatyapi tu snehātputra vakṣyāmi te hitam ।bhūyo vinayamāsthāya bhava nityaṁ jitendriyaḥ ॥2-3-42॥

translations.english: With humility, always keep your senses under control. Keep off all violations arising out of lust and anger.

verses.sloka: कामक्रोधसमुत्थानि त्यजेथा व्यसनानि च ।परोक्षया वर्तमानो वृत्त्या प्रत्यक्षया तथा ॥२-३-४३॥
verses.transliteration: kāmakrodhasamutthāni tyajethā vyasanāni ca ।parokṣayā vartamāno vṛttyā pratyakṣayā tathā ॥2-3-43॥

translations.english: With your behaviour keep the ministers and the people satisfied by means direct or indirect.

verses.sloka: अमात्यप्रभृतीः सर्वाः प्रकृतीश्चानुरञ्जय ।कोष्ठागारायुधागारैः कृत्वा सन्नि चयान् बहून् ॥२-३-४४॥
verses.transliteration: amātyaprabhṛtīḥ sarvāḥ prakṛtīścānurañjaya ।koṣṭhāgārāyudhāgāraiḥ kṛtvā sanni cayān bahūn ॥2-3-44॥

translations.english: You shall rule the earth by filling granaries of foodgrains and arsenals and keeping the subjects loyal and contented. The friends of such a person will memain pleased like devatas with nectar. Hence conduct yourself with your mind under control.

verses.sloka: तुष्टानुरक्तप्रकृतिर्यः पालयति मेदिनीम् ।तस्य नन्दन्ति मित्राणि लब्ध्वाऽमृतमिवाऽमराः ॥२-३-४५॥
verses.transliteration: tuṣṭānuraktaprakṛtiryaḥ pālayati medinīm ।tasya nandanti mitrāṇi labdhvā'mṛtamivā'marāḥ ॥2-3-45॥

translations.english: You shall rule the earth by filling granaries of foodgrains and arsenals and keeping the subjects loyal and contented. The friends of such a person will memain pleased like devatas with nectar. Hence conduct yourself with your mind under control.

verses.sloka: तस्मात्त्वमपि चात्मानं नियम्यैवं समाचर ।तच्छ्रुत्वा सुहृदस्तस्य रामस्य प्रियकारिणः ॥२-३-४६॥
verses.transliteration: tasmāttvamapi cātmānaṁ niyamyaivaṁ samācara ।tacchrutvā suhṛdastasya rāmasya priyakāriṇaḥ ॥2-3-46॥

translations.english: ﻿ Having heard this, Rama's friends quickly reported the matter to Kausalya so that she might be happy.

verses.sloka: त्वरिताः शीघ्रमभ्येत्य कौसल्यायै न्यवेदयन् ।सा हिरण्यं च गाश्चैव रत्नानि विविधानि च ॥२-३-४७॥
verses.transliteration: tvaritāḥ śīghramabhyetya kausalyāyai nyavedayan ।sā hiraṇyaṁ ca gāścaiva ratnāni vividhāni ca ॥2-3-47॥

translations.english: ﻿ The foremost of women, Kausalya ordered gifts of gold, cows and various kinds of gems to be given to the messengers who brought this good tiding.

verses.sloka: व्यादिदेश प्रियाख्येभ्यः कौसल्या प्रमदोत्तमा ।अथाभिवाद्य राजानं रथमारुह्य राघवः ॥२-३-४८॥
verses.transliteration: vyādideśa priyākhyebhyaḥ kausalyā pramadottamā ।athābhivādya rājānaṁ rathamāruhya rāghavaḥ ॥2-3-48॥

translations.english: Having paid his obeisance to the king, Rama ascended the chariot amidst the acclaim of multitudes of men and left for his splendid abode.

verses.sloka: ययौ स्वं द्युतिमद्वेश्म जनौघैः प्रतिपूजितः ।ते चापि पौरा नृपतेर्वचस्त ।च्छ्रुत्वा तदा लाभमिवेष्टमाशु ।नरेन्द्रमामन्त्र्य गृहाणि गत्वा ।देवान् समानर्चुरतिप्रहृष्टाः ॥२-३-४९॥
verses.transliteration: yayau svaṁ dyutimadveśma janaughaiḥ pratipūjitaḥ ।te cāpi paurā nṛpatervacasta ।cchrutvā tadā lābhamiveṣṭamāśu ।narendramāmantrya gṛhāṇi gatvā ।devān samānarcuratiprahṛṣṭāḥ ॥2-3-49॥

translations.english: On hearing such pronouncement by the king, the citizens also felt they have got something beneficial for themselves. They took leave of the king (Dasaratha) and hastening home, full of joy, began worshipping their gods. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे तृतीयस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the third sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
